name: Incremental Subrange Integration
definition: An O(n^2) algorithm for computing pre-integration lookup tables without approximation or hardware assistance, allowing interactive generation for transfer functions with many entries.
summary: Incremental Subrange Integration computes pre-integration lookup tables in O(n^2) time by reusing subrange integrals along diagonals, avoiding the O(n^3) cost of brute-force methods.
